en-US.author: Brink Software B.V.
en-US.description: Efficient digital collaboration during infrastructure projects
en-US.longDescription: To determine the correct timeline, production is recorded per post. The timeline can be submitted digitally and then processed, significantly reducing the lead time for submission and approval. With the app, you can enter productions and fill out logs, even with photos.
en-US.name: Ibis voor Infra

zh-CN.description: 基础设施项目中的高效数字化协作
zh-CN.longDescription: 为确保工期准确，各施工环节的产量均通过数字化方式记录。工期计划可在线提交并处理，从而大幅缩短提交与审批的周期。通过该应用程序，不仅能录入产量数据，还能用照片辅助填写施工日志。
